_comment: Adjudications for the splice markers checks/run.js discovers. The check now asks a real question of the markers it can ask it of -- does an EMITTER of this literal exist anywhere outside the splice call site -- and says plainly that it cannot ask it of the rest. `structural` names the generic HTML fragments whose occurrence count is vacuously satisfied forever: nothing anyone renames can take below two occurrences in a 3 MB document, so a green line about them was never evidence of anything. They are listed rather than counted, and the splices that use them are covered by playtest assertions instead. `singleOccurrence` is the older list: a marker with no emitter at all, allowed only with a reason. Both lists ratchet down as consolidation replaces string-splicing with real seams.

singleOccurrence.<tr><td>Debt service</td>: The ledger builds this row from expRows.push(['Debt service', b.interest]) (~7895) via a generic row renderer, so the literal exists only at the v8 splice (~13508). If the label is renamed, v8Insert's fallback APPENDS the grand-works row at the end of the view (visible misplacement, not silent loss). Eliminated when S2 gives the ledger a real seam.

structural.<div: 824 occurrences. The opening of every div in the file; the count can never fall below two.
structural.</button>: 185 occurrences. Also the cut point for the v9 region-action splice, whose real failure mode is covered by the playtest step `splices-land`.
structural.</div></div>: 129 occurrences. Two closing divs in a row is not a name.
structural.<div class=\"btnrow\">: 50 occurrences. The v10 Question Time splice cuts here; that splice is covered by `splices-land`, which asserts the AUTHORED replies are on screen rather than v8's fixed row.
structural.<div class=\"tagline\">: 39 occurrences. Every party card carries one.
structural.<div class=\"grid\"><div>: 22 occurrences. A layout opening, used by five splices and by ordinary markup.
structural.</article>: 22 occurrences. The cut point inside the region-card splice, covered by `splices-land`.
structural.</div><div class=\"panel\">: 6 occurrences. A panel boundary, not a panel.
structural.</section>: 5 occurrences, two splice sites. The lowest count in this list and still not a name: any section closing anywhere satisfies it.
